title: thelypteris ophiura
intro: Thelypteris ophiura, commonly known as Ophioglossum fern, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Ophioglossaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris ophiura include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris ophiura include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
